why: An automatic discount active Nov 24 makes the sale public on Nov 24.

The problem: an automatic discount applies to everyone the moment it is active. Switch it on for VIPs on Nov 24 and the sale is public on Nov 24 - and the Black Friday email on Nov 27 announces a sale anyone could already see for three days.
The recommendation: run Nov 24-26 as a VIP discount code, then switch to the automatic discount on Nov 27.
The alternative is gating the automatic discount to a customer segment. Shopify may support that on a Buy X Get Y discount - test it rather than assume, before Nov 20.
Whichever way it goes, Taylor needs it before building the Nov 19 email sequence.
